name: consvivisa-erp
description: CONSVIVISA ERP - Backend NestJS + Prisma + PostgreSQL & Frontend React + Vite served as a single service

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.start:prod: npm run db:migrate:deploy --prefix backend && npm run start
